label: Round
author: conky-studio
description: Round to nearest, floor, or ceil with optional decimal places. Richer than the built-in Round (nearest only).
lua_expr:
(function()
 local v, d = {value}, math.floor({decimals} + 0.5)
 if d < 0 then d = 0 end
 local m = 10 ^ d
 local mode = '{mode}'
 if mode == 'floor' then return math.floor(v * m) / m
 elseif mode == 'ceil' then return math.ceil(v * m) / m
 end
 return math.floor(v * m + 0.5) / m
end)()
